description: Create portable Insight risk evidence for one exact unsigned direct Synthetix Perps V3 Base commitOrder call on a reviewed market (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE, PEPE; USDC margin). It verifies the canonical PerpsMarketProxy target, selector, reviewed market id, Pyth settlement strategy, sizeDelta direction, sender, nonce and zero value, then returns a short-lived EIP-712 decision when Insight signing is configured. It never authorizes, signs, or broadcasts the order; bind an ALLOW through PriorSeal or another user-authorization system.
name: base_perp_guard_exact_call
